content.text: I added the Brook Packable Shell in black, size M, to your cart for $98. It was the cheapest of the three waterproof jackets under $150 that come in M. The other two were the Mist Trail Jacket at $128 and the Cedar Rain Shell at $142. The cart now holds only that jacket, so the total is $98. I didn't open checkout or place an order.
